message:
The other day, I found myself in the middle of our family group chat, and it was a lively discussion about what to pack in our go-bags. My daughter suggested snacks, of course, while my son insisted we needed extra batteries for the flashlight. I chuckled at how everyone had their own priorities, but it reminded me that preparedness is really about what makes us feel safe and comfortable. 

We ended up creating a little checklist together, which felt like a nice bonding moment, even if it was over something serious. It’s funny how a simple chat can turn into a plan, turning worry into action. Have you ever had a similar moment with your family?
